'''Plummet bookies''' were individuals living on the lowest levels of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], who took bets relating to corpses that fell down from the higher levels of the [[City/Legends|cityscape]], such as when the next body would arrive, what [[Species/Legends|species]] it would be, and what condition the cadaver would be in.<ref name="Tempest Feud">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref>
